name: Selflessness
overview: Scripture calls believers to a heart oriented away from selfish desires and covetousness, as seen in Psalms 119:36. True selflessness is demonstrated in loving others deeply—loving neighbors as oneself and even loving enemies without expecting anything in return (Mark 12:31; Luke 6:35; Galatians 5:14). This love reflects Christ’s command to love one another as He has loved us (John 15:12) and is expressed practically through compassion and generosity, such as caring for the poor, which is likened to lending to the Lord Himself (Proverbs 19:17).
